svg.title: Two Panels: Black with White Bar II
svg.desc: Schematic visual study after the cited photograph. Approximate geometry and interpretive colors; wall and cast shadows omitted. White upper bar and black lower rectangle retained. Overall physical dimensions established by Guggenheim1996 catalogue62 (199.4 x406.4cm), explicitly credited to Stedelijk; museum conservation reference establishes same title1971 and composition. Perspective in the reference makes contour proportions approximate. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for black, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
